reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V1 (agent's declared 'Shipped variant'): KS yaw-rate psi = (v/L)*tan(delta) with canonical per-platform wheelbase (Mach-E L=2.984, F-150 L=3.70 from agent's parameters.py), minus per-segment mean residual computed on |delta_road|<0.01 rad straight samples (>=5 required).
notes: V1 = KS + per-segment yaw-gyro bias on straights, as defined in agent's tools/run_ladder.py and skills/lateral-fidelity-triage/triage.py. Agent only evaluated on first 20 Mach-E segments; canonical extension applies the same recipe to all 545 Ford segments using each platform's canonical wheelbase from agent's parameters.py.
